_about: Which bin each object goes in, for experiments/pick_and_place.py (read by control/task_config.py). mode: the mode used when --round is not given. Each mode sorts 'by' the object's colour (from the camera) or its shape (the YOLO class, see yolo_dataset/classes.txt); 'bins' maps that colour or shape to the colour of its bin. Change a line here to change the rules; add a mode to add a round.

colour._about: Colour sorting: each object goes in the bin of its own colour.

shape._about: Geometry sorting (Game 1 rules): cube -> red, cylinder -> blue, dodecahedron -> green, hexagonal prism -> yellow.
